scope: Transmission states for Hodgson's military-tribes paper from manuscript/print through Phoenix and 1874, with direct readings distinguished from predicted readings.
central_claim: The 1874 collected text derives from Phoenix reprints that had already incorporated manuscript marginalia from Hodgson's own earlier printed copies. Phoenix is therefore an intermediate material-textual state, not merely a bibliographic reprint.

states.material_state: handwriting on Hodgson's own printed Selections/Illustrations copies
states.evidence: 1874 editor notice plus 1875 Indian Antiquary review

states.material_state: monthly serial print; original issue described as thin-paper, paper-wrap, string-tied fascicle
states.document_state: serial reprint incorporating marginalia from Hodgson's earlier printed copies
states.source_control: Do not promote predicted Phoenix readings to direct readings until pp.31-35 are inspected.

states.confidence: direct text plus near-contemporary transmission evidence

states.military_tribes_evidence: at least one Alderley Oct 1874 copy has annotation recorded on Part II p.37; content unread
states.source_control: Do not treat all annotated author copies as one witness.

states.document_state: selective print extraction from handwritten annotations in an author's copy
states.source_control: The exact physical corrected copy used by Saha and completeness of extraction require verification.

transmission_edges.relation: printed copy reopened as authorial manuscript surface
marginal notes introduced into serial text

transmission_edges.confidence: high from 1875 review; word-level identity not assumed

transmission_edges.relation: printed correction apparatus instructs further revision
individual printed copies become new manuscript surfaces

microrevision_summary.chronology: 1833 70 -> 1857 seventy -> Phoenix unread/probable some -> 1874 base some -> 1874 correction about 100
microrevision_summary.cast_caste: 1833 unresolved -> 1857 caste -> Phoenix unread/probable caste -> 1874 base caste -> 1874 correction cast

source_control_rules: Direct witness reading outranks transmission prediction.
Near-contemporary statements about reprint direction do not guarantee diplomatic word-for-word identity.
Edition-level and copy-specific states must remain distinct.
Do not infer the 1832 manuscript reading from either 1833 or 1874.
Do not infer Phoenix word-level readings until a direct No.26 text/image witness is read.
